output.reason: The release note [ev-282bd56ca274] names the subject and change: the `writeConnectionSecretToRef` field is dropped from v2 composite resources (XRs). The upgrade-guide section [ev-e2dcb3e0ebe6] states the consequence. XRs no longer have native connection-details support, so Crossplane no longer writes their connection details Secret. Managed resources are not affected, and operators must compose their own connection details Secret to keep the behaviour. The evidence does not say whether a field that is still set gets rejected by the schema or silently ignored, and the scope ("v2 XRs" vs. all composite resources) is only implied, so confidence is low.
